name: moneropay-cloud/moneropay-cloud
description: WooCommerce payment gateway for MoneroPay Cloud - a thin PHP adapter over the moneropay-core Rust engine (see docs/WOOCOMMERCE_ROADMAP.md and docs/WOOCOMMERCE_WBS.md in the repo root). This composer.json exists only for the plugin's own PHPUnit test suite and its dev-time dependencies - the plugin itself has zero runtime PHP dependencies beyond WordPress/WooCommerce, deliberately, since every real decision (order state, exchange rates, chain scanning) lives in the Rust engine, not here.
